idea-plugin.name: MyInvois Field Check
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the fields IRBM rejects in a MyInvois JSON payload, on the line, before you submit.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → MyInvois Field Check: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/myinvois-field-check (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/myinvois-field-check

action.text: MyInvois Field Check: Check This File
action.description: Run MyInvois Field Check on the file in the editor
